sources.title: Unitree Go2
sources.specific_reference: Mechanical Specifications and Performance Parameters tables: 12 knee joint motors, standing and crouching dimensions, nominal body weight, maximum climb/drop height, and maximum climb angle.

sources.title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
sources.specific_reference: Results and Materials and Methods: fixed commanded velocities including 0.2 m/s, 0.6 m/s, and eight-direction 0.4 m/s tracking; heading error within 10 degrees; 10 s step trials with front- and hind-leg traversal success; zero planar command for stand-still.

sources.title: Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
sources.specific_reference: Results and figures on constant forward, lateral, and turning commands; pure-pursuit traversal of an inclined platform, raised platform, stairs, and block pile; balance-preserving terrain traversal.

sources.title: Terrain-Aware Quadrupedal Locomotion via Reinforcement Learning
sources.specific_reference: Section IV-A and Table I: rigid block, stair, stepping-stone, and pole terrains; six directions and three runs; five metre map limit; 10-15 cm pole diameters; 8.5, 17, and 25.5 cm stepping-stone gaps.

sources.title: MuJoCo Menagerie: Unitree Go2 model
sources.specific_reference: Pinned unitree_go2/go2.xml: stock Go2 free-base quadruped body, four three-joint legs, actuator names and joint limits used by the local MJCF closure.
